metadata.title: INDIA'S Biggest & BEST Food Festival I AIWAN-e-ZAIQA, Co-curated by Delhi Food Walks I Best of INDIA
metadata.description:
Jashn-e-Rekhta is a three-day festival that celebrates all the facets of Urdu through various art forms.

In 2022, Delhi Food Walks had the privilege to co-curate the Aiwan-e-Zaika food court at this coveted event, which turned out to be its main attraction. 

It was a delightful showcase of handpicked dishes and extraordinary flavours from different parts of the country. 

Hosting the Aiwan E Zaika food court at Jashn-E- Rekhta was an exhilarating experience for us. filled us with immense joy and satisfaction. It was an opportunity to showcase the rich and diverse culinary heritage of India. What a gratifying feeling it was to see the festival come together successfully. 

This episode will take you through the merriment of these three days, where the whole food court was bustling with food lovers all throughout the day. 

As the festival unfolded, there was a palpable sense of exuberance amongst the participants and attendees. The vibrant atmosphere, filled with enticing aromas, vibrant colors and the hustle and bustle of eager food enthusiasts led to a gratifying scene. The participants included the best of names both legendary ones and recent ones. Watch the video to get a glimpse of this most coveted cultural event in the capital.
